ugali_kitchen.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a Kenyan home kitchen: a charcoal jiko with a sufuria on top, a wooden mwiko, a chopping board with sliced onions, an open wooden door, and a shelf holding a closed recipe book with a pot picture on its cover.
ugali_kitchen.alt: A drawing of a Kenyan kitchen with a jiko, a sufuria, a mwiko, a chopping board with onions and a recipe book on a shelf.

amina_healing_finger.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of one teenage girl in a school uniform smiling and holding up one hand with a neat plaster on her finger, standing beside a kitchen table with a wooden chopping board of sliced onions.
amina_healing_finger.alt: A girl smiling and holding up one finger with a neat plaster on it, beside a chopping board with sliced onions.

dqb_sticky_notes_board.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a classroom wall covered in blank yellow and green sticky notes, with three small gold stars stuck beside some notes, and a wooden desk with a pot of pencils in front.
dqb_sticky_notes_board.alt: A classroom wall covered in blank yellow and green sticky notes with small gold stars beside some of them.

onions_and_microscope_table.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a wooden table holding one whole red onion and one whole white onion beside a blue light microscope, with a sunny window behind.
onions_and_microscope_table.alt: A wooden table with a whole red onion and a whole white onion beside a blue light microscope.

lab_bench_onion_slide.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a school laboratory bench holding a blue light microscope, three glass slides, a small dropper bottle, a pair of forceps and half an onion on a white tile.
lab_bench_onion_slide.alt: A school lab bench with a blue light microscope, glass slides, a dropper bottle, forceps and half an onion.

nyama_choma_microbe_vs_cell.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a wooden kiosk table in Nairobi holding a plate of roasted nyama choma beside a blue light microscope, with a big round magnifying glass above showing one large pink round cell next to one tiny green rod-shaped microbe.
nyama_choma_microbe_vs_cell.alt: A drawing of a kiosk table with a plate of nyama choma and a microscope, with a magnifying glass showing a large round cell beside a tiny rod-shaped microbe.

rift_valley_maize_farm.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a sunny Rift Valley maize farm: rows of tall green maize plants, a wooden farm gate, a round water tank on a stand, a small shed with solar panels on its roof and a green escarpment behind.
rift_valley_maize_farm.alt: A drawing of a maize farm in the Rift Valley with maize rows, a gate, a water tank and solar panels on a shed.

desk_plant_cell_outline_sheet.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a wooden classroom desk holding a blank sheet of paper with one large empty rounded outline, a pencil, a green pen and a red pen, with sunlight from a window.
desk_plant_cell_outline_sheet.alt: A school desk with a blank sheet showing one large empty rounded outline, a pencil, a green pen and a red pen.

plant_animal_cell_cutouts.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a bright classroom table holding two large paper cutouts side by side, one square green cell and one round pink cell, each with small coloured shapes inside, beside a jar of coloured pencils.
plant_animal_cell_cutouts.alt: Two paper cell models on a table: a square green plant cell and a round pink animal cell, with a jar of coloured pencils.

blank_cell_outline_desk.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a wooden school desk holding a sheet of white paper with one large empty irregular rounded outline, a sharpened pencil, a green pencil and an orange pencil, with morning light from a window behind.
blank_cell_outline_desk.alt: A school desk with a sheet of paper showing an empty cell outline, and coloured pencils.

cheek_cell_practical_bench.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a school laboratory bench holding a blue light microscope, a pot of clean cotton swabs, three glass slides, a small dropper bottle of blue stain, a box of cover slips and a closed grey bin beside the bench.
cheek_cell_practical_bench.alt: A school lab bench with a blue light microscope, cotton swabs, glass slides, a dropper bottle of blue stain, cover slips and a closed bin.

healing_finger_five_cells.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a big round magnifying glass held over a fingertip with a neat plaster; inside the lens are five differently shaped cells: a pink dimpled disc, a purple cell with a lobed centre, a long branching cell, a tadpole-shaped cell with a long tail, and a long striped fibre.
healing_finger_five_cells.alt: A magnifying glass over a fingertip with a plaster, showing five differently shaped cells inside the lens.

sickle_vs_normal_red_cells.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of two groups of red cells side by side on a pale background: on the left several round red discs with a dip in the middle, on the right several long curved crescent-shaped dark red cells.
sickle_vs_normal_red_cells.alt: A drawing of normal red cells, round with a dip in the middle, beside sickle-shaped red cells, long and curved like a crescent.

bean_seedling_windowsill.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a young bean seedling growing in a clear glass jar on a sunny classroom windowsill, with fine white root hairs, a stiff green stem and two flat green leaves, and a blue sky outside the window.
bean_seedling_windowsill.alt: A bean seedling in a glass jar on a sunny windowsill, showing white root hairs, a green stem and flat green leaves.

githeri_sukuma_plate.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a wooden table in a Kenyan kitchen holding a plate of githeri with a side of green sukuma wiki, a wooden mwiko and a charcoal jiko with a sufuria in the background.
githeri_sukuma_plate.alt: A plate of githeri with sukuma wiki on a wooden table beside a jiko.

school_compound_organisation.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a Kenyan secondary school compound: a long row of blue-roofed classrooms with open doors, a green playing field with two goalposts, a round water tank, shady trees, a school gate and a sunny sky.
school_compound_organisation.alt: A drawing of a school compound with a row of classrooms, a playing field, a water tank, trees and a gate.

then_now_two_sheets_desk.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a wooden classroom desk holding two sheets of paper side by side, the left sheet with a few faint pencil sketches and the right sheet with a bright coloured cell drawing, beside a green pen, a red pen and a pot of sticky notes.
then_now_two_sheets_desk.alt: A desk with two sheets of paper side by side, one with faint pencil sketches and one with a bright coloured cell drawing, beside two pens and sticky notes.

group_poster_model_table.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of a classroom table holding one large blank sheet of poster paper divided into four coloured sections, a tin of coloured markers, a ruler, two closed notebooks and a few small blank yellow and green sticky notes, with sunlight from a window.
group_poster_model_table.alt: A classroom table with a large blank poster divided into four coloured sections, coloured markers, a ruler, two notebooks and sticky notes.

microscope_bench_plain.prompt: A friendly flat cartoon of an empty wooden school bench holding one blue light microscope and two clean glass slides, plain soft background.
microscope_bench_plain.alt: A school science bench with a light microscope and two glass slides
